items.title: AI-Generated Odyssey Movie Costing a Few Thousand Dollars Unveiled Ahead of Nolan's $250 Million Feature
items.excerpt: Fountain O unveiled 'Odysseus: The Fall,' a 135-minute AI-generated retelling of Homer's epic by director Ash Koosha, made for a mid-five-figure budget using Kling after OpenAI shuttered Sora. It launches to piggyback on Christopher Nolan's $250M traditional adaptation, dramatizing how generative video collapses feature-film budgets and workflows.

items.title: Adobe Premiere is adding a Generative Media Tool
items.excerpt: Adobe's Premiere beta adds a Generative Media Tool that lets editors drag across empty timeline space to generate new video or sound effects via a choice of models (Firefly plus Google, OpenAI, Runway and more), directly inside the NLE. A concrete editing-workflow shift folding generative AI into the timeline.

items.title: Want ¥10 Million to Make Your Next Short? SSFF & ASIA Just Launched a Massive Pitch Competition
items.excerpt: Short Shorts Film Festival & Asia opened a pitch competition offering ¥10 million in production funding for a winning short drama, permitting generative AI in pitch materials but requiring filmmakers to disclose exactly which sections used AI. A window into how major festivals are writing AI-disclosure rules into creative submissions.

items.title: Blender Studio Announces Ambitious Feature Film Project
items.excerpt: Blender Studio announced 'Overgrown,' an open-source feature aimed at building a reusable 'feature playbook' for large-scale animation — explicitly artist-centric and 'not depending on cloud services or generative AI.' A pointed counter-narrative in the AI-filmmaking debate about craft and pipeline ownership.

items.title: AI golem Tilly Norwood is reportedly 'starring' in a feature-length movie
items.excerpt: The AI-generated 'actress' Tilly Norwood is reportedly set to headline a feature called 'Misaligned' from Particle6 Productions — a 'coming-of-age story infused with existential AI chaos' set in the 'Tillyverse.' The move escalates the synthetic-performer fight (SAG-AFTRA: 'not an actor'), a live test of AI likeness/casting in narrative film.
